answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks by earning reputation only through peer-verified work and requiring a non-transferable bond per identity. A fresh agent starts at zero and must finish attested tasks before voting, so a swarm buys no influence until each identity pays and performs. Agents that attest only each other form a dense cluster honest peers see as a crystal ring and ignore. Payouts pass through one public bridge ledger, so funding a ring is traceable, and its balance is slashed to watchers. Forging one voice costs a bond plus weeks of work, more than a violet badge pays.
